preconditions.description: The number of settlements n must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of affected settlements m must be between 0 and n.
The damage range d must be between 0 and n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: All affected settlements p1, p2, ..., pm must be valid settlement numbers between 1 and n.
The affected settlements must be distinct.
There must be exactly n - 1 paths connecting the settlements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in paths)
preconditions.description: All paths must connect valid settlement numbers between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of settlements that may contain the Book of Evil.
The count of possible settlements must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: count == 0 if not any(settlements) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid settlements are found, the output must be 0.
